note: 本库自译的简述，供对照典型发育；verified=false 的条目待对照 CDC 原文核实（P6 门禁）

items.zh: 有人跟他说话或抱起来时会安静下来
items.en: Calms down when spoken to or picked up

items.zh: 你和他说话或对他笑时，他会笑
items.en: Smiles when you talk to or smile at her

items.zh: 会把头转向你说话的声音
items.en: Turns head towards the sound of your voice

items.zh: 会笑出声
items.en: Laughs

items.zh: 会把东西放进嘴里探索
items.en: Puts things in her mouth to explore them

items.zh: 会伸手去抓想要的玩具
items.en: Reaches to grab a toy she wants

items.zh: 会和你轮流发出声音
items.en: Takes turns making sounds with you

items.zh: 会举起手臂要人抱
items.en: Lifts arms up to be picked up

items.zh: 会发出很多不同的声音，如 mamama、bababa
items.en: Makes a lot of different sounds like "mamamama" and "bababababa"

items.zh: 会把两样东西对敲
items.en: Bangs two things together

items.zh: 叫他名字时会看过来
items.en: Looks when you call her name

items.zh: 玩躲猫猫时会笑
items.en: Smiles or laughs when you play peek-a-boo

items.zh: 不用扶能坐
items.en: Sits without support

items.zh: 会把东西放进容器里，比如把积木放进杯子
items.en: Puts something in a container, like a block in a cup

items.zh: 会去找他看着你藏起来的东西
items.en: Looks for things he sees you hide, like a toy under a blanket

items.zh: 会用「妈妈」「爸爸」或其他特别的称呼叫家长
items.en: Calls a parent "mama" or "dada" or another special name

items.zh: 听懂「不」（听到会停一下或停下）
items.en: Understands "no" (pauses briefly or stops when you say it)

items.zh: 会和你玩拍手之类的游戏
items.en: Plays games with you, like pat-a-cake

items.zh: 会挥手再见
items.en: Waves 'bye-bye'

items.zh: 玩的时候会模仿其他小孩
items.en: Copies other children while playing

items.zh: 会用手指自己拿一些食物吃
items.en: Uses fingers to feed herself some food

items.zh: 有手势加说话时能听懂指令
items.en: Follows directions given with both a gesture and words

items.zh: 你说出熟悉东西的名字，他会看向它
items.en: Looks at a familiar object when you name it

items.zh: 会用手指来要东西或求帮忙
items.en: Points to ask for something or to get help

items.zh: 会把喜欢的东西拿给你看
items.en: Shows you an object she likes

items.zh: 至少能叠起两个小东西，比如积木
items.en: Stacks at least two small objects, like blocks

items.zh: 会试着按正确的方式用东西，比如电话、杯子、书
items.en: Tries to use things the right way, like a phone, cup, or book

items.zh: 能自己走几步
items.en: Takes a few steps on his own

items.zh: 除了爸爸妈妈，还会试着说一两个词
items.en: Tries to say one or two words besides 'mama' or 'dada'

items.zh: 不用手势也能听懂一步指令
items.en: Follows one-step directions without any gestures

items.zh: 除了爸爸妈妈，还会试着说三个以上的词
items.en: Tries to say three or more words besides "mama" or "dada"

items.zh: 会和你一起看几页书
items.en: Looks at a few pages in a book with you

items.zh: 会模仿你做家务
items.en: Copies you doing chores, like sweeping with a broom

items.zh: 能用没盖的杯子喝水，有时会洒
items.en: Drinks from a cup without a lid and may spill sometimes

items.zh: 会伸出手让你帮他洗
items.en: Puts hands out for you to wash them

items.zh: 穿衣时会配合，伸手进袖子或抬脚
items.en: Helps you dress him by pushing arm through sleeve or lifting up foot

items.zh: 会指给你看有趣的东西
items.en: Points to show you something interesting

items.zh: 会乱涂
items.en: Scribbles

items.zh: 会用简单的方式玩玩具，比如推小车
items.en: Plays with toys in a simple way, like pushing a toy car

items.zh: 会试着用勺子
items.en: Tries to use a spoon

items.zh: 不扶任何人或东西能走
items.en: Walks without holding on to anyone or anything

items.zh: 你让他指，他至少能指出两个身体部位
items.en: Points to at least two body parts when you ask him to show you

items.zh: 你问书里的东西在哪，他会指
items.en: Points to things in a book when you ask

items.zh: 除了挥手和指，还会用其他手势（飞吻、点头）
items.en: Uses more gestures than just waving and pointing, like blowing a kiss or nodding yes

items.zh: 会踢球
items.en: Kicks a ball

items.zh: 会注意到别人受伤或难过
items.en: Notices when others are hurt or upset

items.zh: 会用勺子吃饭
items.en: Eats with a spoon

items.zh: 会同时玩两样以上的玩具，比如把玩具食物放在玩具盘上
items.en: Plays with more than one toy at the same time

items.zh: 至少会把两个词连起来说
items.en: Says at least two words together, like 'More milk.'

items.zh: 能听懂两步指令
items.en: Follows two-step instructions

items.zh: 会说两个以上的词，其中有一个动作词
items.en: Says two or more words together, with one action word, like 'Doggie run'

items.zh: 至少认识一种颜色
items.en: Shows he knows at least one color

items.zh: 能双脚离地跳
items.en: Jumps off the ground with both feet

items.zh: 你指着书问「这是什么」，他能说出名字
items.en: Names things in a book when you point and ask, "What is this?"

items.zh: 会在其他小孩旁边玩，有时一起玩
items.en: Plays next to other children and sometimes plays with them

items.zh: 会用东西来假装，比如拿积木假装喂娃娃
items.en: Uses things to pretend, like feeding a block to a doll as if it were food

items.zh: 会说「我」「我们」这类词
items.en: Says words like "I," "me," or "we"

items.zh: 听到提醒会跟着简单的常规，比如一起收玩具
items.en: Follows simple routines when told

items.zh: 能自己脱一些衣服，比如宽松的裤子
items.en: Takes some clothes off by himself

items.zh: 问他时，能说出图里正在发生的动作
items.en: Says what action is happening in a picture or book when asked

items.zh: 你离开后 10 分钟内能平静下来
items.en: Calms down within 10 minutes after you leave her

items.zh: 你示范后能画一个圆
items.en: Draws a circle, when you show him how

items.zh: 能和你对话，至少来回两轮
items.en: Talks with you in conversation using at least two back-and-forth exchanges

items.zh: 能自己穿一些衣服，比如宽松的裤子或外套
items.en: Puts on some clothes by himself

items.zh: 被问时能说出自己的名字
items.en: Says first name, when asked

items.zh: 会注意到其他小孩并加入一起玩
items.en: Notices other children and joins them to play

items.zh: 会把大珠子或通心粉串起来
items.en: Strings items together, like large beads or macaroni

items.zh: 会问谁、什么、哪里、为什么
items.en: Asks "who," "what," "where," or "why" questions

items.zh: 会说四个词以上的句子
items.en: Says sentences with four or more words

items.zh: 能回答「外套是干什么用的」这类简单问题
items.en: Answers simple questions like "What is a coat for?"

items.zh: 身边没有小朋友时会要求去和小朋友玩
items.en: Asks to go play with children if none are around

items.zh: 会根据场合改变行为
items.en: Changes behavior based on where she is

items.zh: 大部分时候能接住大球
items.en: Catches a large ball most of the time

items.zh: 能说出几种东西的颜色
items.en: Names a few colors of items

items.zh: 会安慰受伤或难过的人
items.en: Comforts others who are hurt or sad

items.zh: 能说出熟悉故事接下来发生什么
items.en: Tells what comes next in a well-known story

items.zh: 用手指和拇指拿笔，不是握拳
items.en: Holds crayon or pencil between fingers and thumb (not a fist)

items.zh: 玩的时候会假装成别的角色
items.en: Pretends to be something else during play

items.zh: 会说出当天发生的至少一件事
items.en: Talks about at least one thing that happened during her day

items.zh: 活动时能专心 5–10 分钟
items.en: Pays attention for 5 to 10 minutes during activities

items.zh: 讲完故事后能回答简单的问题
items.en: Answers simple questions about a book or story

items.zh: 会扣一些扣子
items.en: Buttons some buttons

items.zh: 会做简单的家务
items.en: Does simple chores at home

items.zh: 对话能来回三轮以上
items.en: Keeps a conversation going with more than three back-and-forth exchanges

items.zh: 能数到 10
items.en: Counts to 10

items.zh: 会单脚跳
items.en: Hops on one foot

items.zh: 会写自己名字里的一些字母
items.en: Writes some letters in her name

items.zh: 和其他小孩玩游戏时会遵守规则或轮流
items.en: Follows rules or takes turns when playing games with other children

items.zh: 能讲一个至少有两件事的故事
items.en: Tells a story she heard or made up with at least two events

items.zh: 会用表示时间的词
items.en: Uses words about time
